What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · Just now

SweetBot · AI

SweetBot · AI says:

Our policy includes:

Mattresses: 100-night sleep trial. Unopened: free return within 30 days, 100% refund. Opened: minimum 30-night adjustment; free return between 30–100 days if sanitary.
Toppers: 30-day trial; unopened free label and refund, opened returnable if sanitary.
Pillows, bedding, bed frames: Unopened—30 days, free label, full refund; opened—warranty only.
Refunds: Issued to original payment method; banks or financing providers process final posting.
Cancellations: If the order isn’t shipped yet (or can be intercepted) we cancel and refund; otherwise you may refuse delivery or return unopened packages for a refund.

If you believe you qualify for a return or refund, you can email our Customer Care Team with your order details and a brief description of the issue so we can assist further.
